description: This file contains the implementation of serialization, surrogate conversion, and deep copying for ImmutableArray<T> in the Orleans serialization framework. It defines a serializer class, a surrogate struct, and a copier class specific to ImmutableArray<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableArrayCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableArray<T> that converts to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: ImmutableArraySurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type used during serialization of ImmutableArray<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableArrayCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableArray<T> that supports shallow and deep copying.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into an ImmutableArray<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableArray<T> into its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableArray<T>.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Indicates whether the copier can perform shallow copies.
